title: AppConfig
description: One app of the three-app engine (PLAN.md C-A3). Rust (api/src/app/config.rs, serde) and TS (apps/web/shared/apps, zod) load the same files; a conformance test loads all three in both.

id.description: App id; also the route prefix (/v1/{id}/...), the data dir (<INVERSA_DATA_DIR>/{id}) and the room prefix ({id}:main).

question.description: The one question the app answers (docs/APPS.md).

kind.description: species: hotspot grid, frames, taxa. conditions: readings, forecast snapshots and alerts per location; no hotspot grid.

provisional.description: True while the app's locations/regions are placeholders awaiting a data proof.

taxa.description: The focus taxon of a species app (TaxonIdx 0 in frames); empty for conditions apps. One species per app.

short.description: Chip label ("Python"); the name when absent.

line.description: One plain line for the welcome guide.

aliases.description: Other names people use for it, matched lower case by the agent.

inatLineageIds.description: Further iNat taxon ids that collapse to this taxon (e.g. the species under a genus).

gbifKey.description: GBIF backbone key; matched against speciesKey and genusKey.

nasSpecies.description: NAS species epithet; null matches any species of the genus.

rules.description: Named activity/access rule set in api/src/hotspot/rules.rs.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees. Width and height must be whole multiples of 10 x cellDeg (the hotspot grid is 2 x cellDeg, the environment grid 5 x cellDeg).

cellDeg.description: Scoring cell size in degrees (0.01 for every current app).

heightM.description: Camera height above the ellipsoid in metres (the web's altitudeM).

thin.description: Data proof found too few recent records for a ranked score; the UI labels it.

code.description: Short area code for result lines and labels (fl, mx); the id when absent.

locations.description: Named points (conditions apps). Provisional until a data proof lands.

nwsGrid.description: NWS forecast grid cell from /points/{lat},{lon} (gridId, gridX, gridY); the gridpoint poller needs no points lookup.

nwsZones.description: UGC codes of the location (forecast zone LAZ033, county LAC097): zone-based alerts match a site through these.

note.description: Why the site is in the set; data caveats (datum, missing discharge).

cameraPresets.description: Named map cameras for the UI preset list (conditions apps).

locations.description: Location ids the preset frames; empty = all.

params.description: Adapter parameters (stations, variables, sectors). Free-form per adapter.

label.description: What the score is called in the UI; it is a labelled heuristic, never a probability.

id.description: Layer id; the web draws the ids in apps/web/shared/apps/schema.ts LAYER_IDS and ignores the others until a client layer exists.

legend.description: Legend text per layer id; every key names a layer in layers[].

timezone.description: IANA zone of the app's local times (clock, day boundaries). A closed list so Rust and the web accept the same files.

copy.description: UI strings. about, region and timezone are read by name; other keys are free-form.

tools.description: Tool allowlist (capability names in apps/web/server/agent/tools/capabilities.ts, e.g. sightings, explain_cell, set_view).

refusal.description: Text for out-of-scope questions; names what the app covers.

review.description: Needs-review thresholds of a conditions app (api/src/review). Every field optional; defaults shown. Not allowed on species apps.

stageRiseFt.description: Observed NWPS stage rise over 24 h that flags review.

tidalSites.description: NWPS ids whose stage carries tide; the tidal floors apply.

rapidRiseFtPer24h.description: Forecast rise within any 24 h of the horizon that flags review.

conflictFt.description: NWPS gauge vs NWPS forecast stage difference that is a source conflict.

flowConflictRatio.description: NWPS vs USGS flow ratio that is a source conflict.

$comment: Rules beyond JSON Schema, enforced by both loaders (api/src/app/config.rs validate, apps/web/shared/apps/schema.ts): ids unique per list; scientificName unique; region bbox west < east and south < north, edges whole multiples of 10 x cellDeg, regions never overlap; feed mode equals its source's mode; windows.defaultHours in optionsHours; text fields are not blank after trimming.
